Contributing to flexCountReg

Source: .github/CONTRIBUTING.md

Bug reports and pull requests are welcome at https://github.com/jwood-iastate/flexCountReg/issues. Please include a minimal reproducible example (reprex::reprex()).

Development workflow

  • Code style: the tidyverse style guide, 80-character lines.
  • Documentation: roxygen2 (run devtools::document(); the version in DESCRIPTION under Config/roxygen2/version is the one used to generate the man/ files).
  • Tests: testthat edition 3. Every bug fix gets a regression test that fails before the fix. Prefer tests that check results (closed forms, reference implementations, simulation recovery, invariances) over tests that only check that code runs. Mark slow stochastic tests with skip_on_cran().
  • Model families are defined once, in R/families.R; data preparation and prediction blueprints in R/model_data.R.

Release checklist

  1. devtools::document() and devtools::build_readme().
  2. devtools::test() with no failures and no unexpected warnings.
  3. devtools::check(remote = TRUE, manual = TRUE) with no errors, warnings or notes; urlchecker::url_check(); devtools::spell_check().
  4. Check on the minimum R version in DESCRIPTION, on R-devel (rhub::rhub_check()), and with only the hard dependencies installed (the no-suggests CI job).
  5. Update NEWS.md (user-visible changes, including changed results) and the version number in DESCRIPTION.
  6. Build the pkgdown site and check the vignettes.
  7. devtools::submit_cran(); tag the release on GitHub.
